themes.name: VECTOR GRID
themes.feel: Neon light-lines racing across an endless dark grid.
themes.best_for: AI infrastructure, data flows, platform launches
themes.look: Black void, cyan light-lines with white-hot cores, and one orange "rival" force. One-point perspective floor grid, horizon glow, hard 90° geometry. No grain; bloom on lines only.
themes.motion: Constant-velocity runs that break into hard 90° turns. "Wire-in" builds go wireframe, then fill, then glow. "Shard-out" exits break into square shards. `expo.out`, 400 to 800 ms.

slots.S1: perspective grid floor scrolling toward the horizon while a light-trail draws the headline (T1 CSS 3D + gradient grid; T3 option: three.js grid with bloom).
slots.S2: DrawSVG light-trails linking section points at right angles.
slots.S4: bars as glowing light-walls (scaleY only), lines as trails with a fading wake.
slots.S5: neon focus rings with circuit-trace corners.

themes.video: Cold open riding the grid at speed, cuts on 90° turns landing on downbeats, titles wiring in line by line. Arpeggiated synth with a sub pulse, 100 to 120 BPM.
themes.data_skin: Hairline luminous strokes, no fills, mono values. The rival series is always the orange.
themes.boardroom: Deep navy ground, grid at 8% opacity, cyan only on the key path, no shards.
themes.guardrails: No light-racing vehicles, throwing-disc weapons or circuit-lined suits on human figures, and no recreated title styling. Keep the light abstract: lines, grids and shards.
themes.collision: Sits near sci-fi dashboard builds. Keep VECTOR GRID about motion through space, not HUD panels.
themes.seed: TX-01 VECTOR GRID: inside-the-machine neon geometry; cyan light-lines on black with one orange rival; wire-in reveals, right-angle light-trail connectors, shard-out exits.

themes.name: PHOSPHOR RAIN
themes.feel: Green code cascading until the hidden truth resolves.
themes.best_for: Threat intel, hidden-system reveals, AI
themes.look: Near-black green, falling glyph columns with a bright lead glyph, phosphor bloom. A "real world" chapter switches the grade to cold steel blue (`--tx-a3`). **Build the rain from the subject's own material** (its keywords, hex of its data, its numerals), never a borrowed glyph set. This is the theme's uniqueness lever.
themes.motion: Columns fall at varied speeds; headings decode out of noise; one "freeze-orbit" moment where scroll stops time and circles a single data point. Decodes run 600 to 900 ms.

slots.S1: canvas rain that resolves into the headline (T2 to T3; 60 columns desktop, 24 mobile; stops or pauses after 5 s).
slots.S2: ScrambleText decode on section heads.
slots.S4: numbers decode from glyph noise to the true value, which sits in the DOM.
slots.S5: terminal caret and green focus outline.

themes.video: Black frame with a blinking cursor, rain resolving into the title, green "inside" scenes cut against steel-blue "outside" scenes, a freeze-orbit shot for the key stat. Low industrial pulse with glitch percussion, 90 to 100 BPM.
themes.data_skin: 5-step monochrome green ramp, mono numerals, glyph-noise texture in empty chart space at 5%.
themes.boardroom: Rain only in the hero at 15% opacity or less, frozen after 3 s; decode accents on KPIs only.
themes.guardrails: Rain glyphs come from the subject, never a borrowed or mirrored glyph set. No two-pill choice motif, no figures in long coats and dark glasses, no phone-booth exits, no film dialogue.
themes.collision: Sits near threat-intel builds with spectrogram or heap-grid signatures. Vary the S1 family if either shipped in the last two builds.
themes.seed: TX-02 PHOSPHOR RAIN: code rain built from this subject's own words and numbers; truths decode out of noise; one freeze-orbit data moment; green inside, steel-blue outside.

themes.name: GLASS HUD
themes.feel: Translucent data panels assembling around one datum.
themes.best_for: Monitoring, CI dashboards, agent systems
themes.look: Deep navy, translucent glass panels, ice-cyan linework, amber thresholds, one alert red. A central datum surrounded by orbiting panels, brackets, tick ladders and reticles. B612 Mono was drawn for cockpit legibility, so it suits dense readouts.
themes.motion: Staged boot sequences: lines draw, brackets snap, labels scramble, values settle. Micro moves 150 to 300 ms, assemblies 800 ms, `power2.out`, parallax depth between glass layers. Blur is applied to static layers only and never animated.

slots.S1: panels assemble in depth around the headline datum (CSS 3D + static backdrop blur, T2; T3 option: three.js).
slots.S2: panel boot per section.
slots.S4: radial gauges, ring meters, sparklines with tick ladders.

themes.video: Camera pushes through glass layers toward the subject; callouts track to it; panel wipes. Low synth bed, 80 to 90 BPM, sparse UI chirps (video only; web stays silent).
themes.data_skin: Thin rings, bracketed labels, tabular mono numerals, amber for any threshold crossing.
themes.boardroom: Native. Cap it at 3 panels per view and stop the rotating reticles.
themes.guardrails: No armored suits or helmets, no named AI assistants from films, no gesture-glove props and no prediction-chamber imagery.
themes.collision: The highest dashboard-collision risk in the codex. Set the HUD over something real (a photo, a map, a document) rather than shipping another standalone dashboard.
themes.seed: TX-03 GLASS HUD: translucent panels boot up around one decisive datum; brackets snap, values settle; amber marks every threshold crossing.

themes.name: RAINLIGHT NOIR
themes.feel: Rain, haze and neon reflections in a city that watches.
themes.best_for: Privacy, data brokers, AI ethics, future of work
themes.look: Wet blacks, teal shadow, sodium-orange haze, magenta and cyan signage, rain highlights. Tall verticals, layered haze, floor reflections, ad-scale typography. Any non-English signage must be real, correctly written words, or left out.
themes.motion: Slow push-ins and dissolves of 1.2 to 2.5 s. Neon signs flicker on with 2 flickers at most, under 3 per second. Rain is constant but pausable.

slots.S1: rain on glass over a neon-bokeh scene, title flickering on as a sign (VFX-JS custom shader or canvas droplets; the page's one WebGL layer).
slots.S2: slow dolly reveals: scale plus a crossfade between pre-blurred layers.
slots.S4: tall translucent "billboard" stat panels with a scanning light.

themes.video: Long takes, slow push-ins, reflections, silhouettes against haze, 2.39:1 letterbox. Lush analog brass pads and long reverb, 60 to 80 BPM or free time.
themes.data_skin: Bars as vertical light columns, orange-vs-teal for two series, tall condensed caps for labels.
themes.boardroom: Keep haze and palette. Rain freezes after 5 s, no flicker, neon only as underline accents.
themes.guardrails: No synthetic-human interrogation tests, origami figures, flying police vehicles, invented megacorporations, or recreated skyline shots.
themes.collision: Sits near dark forensic looks; differentiate through the rain-and-neon S1. A strong fit for data-broker and privacy stories.
themes.seed: TX-04 RAINLIGHT NOIR: a rain-streaked, neon-lit city that watches back; slow push-ins through haze; signage-scale numbers; orange versus teal.

themes.name: STUTTER BROADCAST
themes.feel: A pirate-TV host stuttering through a glitching broadcast.
themes.best_for: Synthetic media, AI presenters, media disruption
themes.look: Black studio void behind a rotating box of colored lines. Saturated magenta, cyan, yellow and electric blue; scanlines; generic test-card bars. An "on-air" frame: a central presenter window, a lower-third chyron, an original station bug in the corner.
themes.motion: The stutter-repeat. A word or frame repeats 2 to 3 times with a jitter before it lands ("re-re-revenue"). Frame holds, channel-change cuts with 200 ms of static at most, a tracking band rolling through.

slots.S1: rotating line-box backdrop (CSS 3D, T1 to T2) behind an on-air frame, with the headline stuttering in.
slots.S2: stutter-repeat reveals on section heads; the repeats sit in `aria-hidden` spans and the real text appears once.
slots.S4: charts "change channel" between states (crossfade + 150 ms noise).
slots.S5: a LIVE bug and chyron-style hovers.

themes.video: News-desk framing, a presenter cut off by interruptions, stutter edits on the beat, interlace artifacts, a 4:3 frame inside 16:9. Synth-pop at 110 to 120 BPM, chopped vocal stabs (original), short static stings.
themes.data_skin: Flat primary bars on black, VT323 tickers, key numbers delivered as "breaking" chyrons.
themes.boardroom: News-desk format only: chyrons, lower thirds, a ticker and clean cuts. No stutter, glitch or chroma.
themes.guardrails: No recreation of an existing synthetic presenter's face, hair, wardrobe or name, and no lines from any show. Any AI host must be an original design.
themes.collision: Sits near host-led stories. The natural home for AI presenters, avatars and synthetic-media stories.
themes.seed: TX-05 STUTTER BROADCAST: a pirate-TV broadcast fronted by an original synthetic host; stutter-repeat headlines; channel-change data transitions; chyrons for every key number.

themes.name: OTHERSIDE ’83
themes.feel: 1983 night, a red-glow title, and a world flipped under the surface.
themes.best_for: Hidden risk, "under the surface" data, TTRPG, nostalgia
themes.look: A 1983 night: blue-black, a crimson title glow, warm practical lamps, cream paper. Display is Fraunces at weight 900, tightly tracked, outlined, with a red outer glow; it reads as 80s paperback, not as any franchise's lockup. The "flipped" chapter goes desaturated blue-grey with drifting ash. VHS noise stays at 8% or less over text.
themes.motion: A slow title assembly where letters drift together and kern tight over 3 to 4 s. VHS tracking-roll between chapters, flashlight reveals in dark sections, particles drifting slowly upward.

slots.S1: the title assembly in glowing outlined serif over a dark field (T1 to T2; no autoplay audio).
slots.S2: VHS tracking-roll transitions (clip + offset, 300 ms or less).
slots.S3: floating ash (tsParticles slim, 40 desktop / 20 mobile) + film grain.
slots.S4: charts as 80s graph-paper plots and photocopied handouts; the flipped chapter shows the same chart with the hidden variable revealed.
slots.S5: a flashlight spotlight cursor, gated to `(hover:hover)`; touch gets a static vignette.

themes.video: A slow push on the title, analog synth arpeggios at 80 to 100 BPM, dissolves, practical-light flicker under 3 per second.
themes.data_skin: Two-worlds comparisons, surface versus underneath. "Hidden" series are dashed until the flip.
themes.boardroom: Tempered is the ceiling. Keep the two-worlds device and palette; drop the VHS roll and the flashlight cursor.
themes.guardrails: No series title lockup or its typeface, no creatures or characters, no alphabet-light wall, no named town or lab, no kids-on-bikes silhouettes.
themes.collision: Sits near dark case-file looks. A strong fit for TTRPG work and for 'what's under the surface' risk stories.
themes.seed: TX-06 OTHERSIDE ’83: a 1983-night story with a glowing serif title; every key chart has a flipped 'other side' that reveals the hidden variable; ash drifts, VHS rolls between chapters.

themes.name: NIGHT DRIVE
themes.feel: A pink-and-cyan night cruise toward a striped sunset.
themes.best_for: Event promos, community, retro gaming
themes.look: Deep violet sky, hot-pink and cyan neon, a striped setting sun on a magenta horizon grid, generic palm and skyline silhouettes, chrome type. Unlike TX-01's cold interior cyberspace, this is a warm, analog sunset.
themes.motion: The cruise: long eased scrolls (`sine.inOut`, 1 to 1.5 s), neon flicking on, passing-light streaks across the frame, slow-motion holds.

slots.S1: a striped sun sinking behind a scrolling horizon grid under a chrome title (T1 CSS; T3 option: a shader sun).
slots.S2: neon-sign flicker-on headers + script underline draw.
slots.S4: equalizer bars and gradient chrome numerals.

themes.video: Passing lights through a car window, mirror framing with no identifiable car, script title cards, synthwave at 85 to 118 BPM with gated-reverb drums.
themes.data_skin: Pink-to-cyan gradient bars, outlined neon numerals.
themes.boardroom: Avoid. If forced, keep only the palette, muted to dusk violet.
themes.guardrails: No recreations of specific TV openings, film title scripts or costume pieces, and no real car models or brands.
themes.collision: Clear. Best for community event promos, launches and retro gaming.
themes.seed: TX-07 NIGHT DRIVE: a neon night cruise toward a striped sunset; chrome numerals, script accents, headers that flick on like signs; momentum without hurry.

themes.name: COLD STORAGE
themes.feel: Chunky CRT terminals humming in a cold industrial hull.
themes.best_for: System status, audits, monitoring, legacy tech
themes.look: Green and amber CRT text on black, beige plastic consoles, gunmetal panels, red alarm lamps. Rounded screen bezels, curvature vignette, phosphor persistence. DSEG7 supplies the 7-segment numerals.
themes.motion: Line-by-line type-on with a block cursor, vector wireframes drawing stroke by stroke, status lamps blinking at 1 Hz, slow tracking moves.

slots.S1: a monochrome vector wireframe (terrain, schematic or data structure) drawing onto a CRT beside live status readouts (DrawSVG + CSS scanlines, T1 to T2).
slots.S2: terminal type-on section heads (TextPlugin; real text in the DOM).
slots.S3: CRT vignette, 2% scanlines, a faint hum flicker at 3% opacity or less and 2 Hz or less.
slots.S4: segmented bar meters, 7-segment counters, blinking threshold lamps.

themes.video: Slow pans across instrument panels, blinking lights, long silences. Ship hum and relay clicks; no score, or a sparse drone.
themes.data_skin: Segmented bars, monochrome green with amber thresholds; red only for a breach.
themes.boardroom: Ready as is. Drop phosphor trails and blinking; keep the terminal grammar and segmented meters.
themes.guardrails: No ship or onboard-computer names, no creature, egg or biomechanical forms, no film corporation logos, no franchise wordmark.
themes.collision: Sits near security builds with heap-grid or sonar signatures. Prefer non-security subjects, or a different S1 family when either shipped recently.
themes.seed: TX-08 COLD STORAGE: a humming late-70s ship console; vector wireframes draw onto green CRTs; segmented meters and 7-segment counters; red appears only at breach.

themes.name: SPACE OPERA
themes.feel: A perspective crawl, starfields and wipes at mythic scale.
themes.best_for: Origin sagas, multi-part series, campaign settings
themes.look: Star-black, a warm gold title color, cool steel greys, hyperspace-blue streaks. Deep space, low planet horizons, symmetric wide frames. Oswald at weight 700 for titles, News Cycle for crawl and body.
themes.motion: A perspective text crawl (rotateX about 25°, scroll-scrubbed). Wipes as chapter transitions: horizontal, clock and iris, the classic serial-film grammar. Hyperspace streak bursts of 500 ms or less.

slots.S1: a scroll-scrubbed crawl receding into a starfield, then tilting down into chapter one (T1 CSS 3D; starfield canvas T2).
slots.S2: wipe transitions between chapters (clip-path; the clock wipe uses a conic-gradient mask).
slots.S4: fleet-style unit charts (small glyph units), star-map networks, episode timelines.
slots.S5: a hyperspace streak on CTA click.

themes.video: Crawl, then tilt down to a planet; wipes between scenes; orchestral brass with a short original motif per faction or competitor.
themes.data_skin: Gold on black, Roman-numeral episodes, factions as color pairs.
themes.boardroom: Tempered is the ceiling. Keep the wipes and the episode structure. Use the crawl only if the intro is 60 words or fewer and also readable as plain text.
themes.guardrails: No famous opening line or its variants, no franchise logo or its crawl yellow, no glowing swords, ships, robots or helmets from films, no franchise terminology.
themes.collision: Sits near starfield builds. Use a different starfield treatment, or drop S3, if one is among the last two builds.
themes.seed: TX-09 SPACE OPERA: an episodic saga opened by a receding crawl; chapters change by wipe; competitors as factions on a star map; gold on black.

themes.name: SANDSCALE
themes.feel: Monumental forms rising from haze; tiny figures, vast forces.
themes.best_for: Macro forces, market scale, geopolitics
themes.look: A light theme: pale haze ground, sand ochre, basalt shadow, one ember accent. Extreme scale contrast, with a tiny human-scale marker against a massive form. 2.39:1 letterbox, heavy negative space, Syncopate in widely spaced caps. An "infrared" chapter switches to high-key black and white for the threat or antagonist data.
themes.motion: Slow and heavy: 1.5 to 3 s, `power2.inOut`. Forms rise out of haze; sand-sweep wipes through noise masks; light camera shake on the S1 only.

slots.S1: a monumental reveal: a ridge, a structure or the key number at architectural scale rising from layered haze above a tiny marker (layered parallax, T1 to T2).
slots.S2: sand-sweep noise-mask wipes.
slots.S3: drifting particulate (30 max) + static heat shimmer.
slots.S4: bars as textured stone slabs, contour terrain charts for distributions, tiny figures for per-capita comparisons.

themes.video: Extreme wides, slow pushes, silhouettes on ridgelines, long holds. Sub-bass drones and low choral textures.
themes.data_skin: Slabs, contours and scale figures. Every comparison is drawn at true proportion.
themes.boardroom: Native. Cap haze at 3 layers.
themes.guardrails: No giant worms, desert survival suits, flapping-wing aircraft, noble-house sigils, invented resource names or glyph alphabets, and no custom wordmark. No black monolith slab either; that belongs to TX-12's genre.
themes.collision: Sits near contour-terrain builds. Avoid a contour-terrain S1 if one is among the last two builds.
themes.seed: TX-10 SANDSCALE: forces too large to see whole; the key number rises from haze at architectural scale over a tiny human marker; slow, heavy, ochre; an infrared chapter for the threat.

themes.name: WASTELAND CHROME
themes.feel: Orange-and-teal pursuit at full throttle, center-framed.
themes.best_for: Disruption, competitive races, crisis and survival
themes.look: Burnt-orange desert, teal sky, crushed blacks, chrome highlights, dust. A day-for-night blue chapter. Subjects sit dead center so the eye never hunts during fast cuts.

slots.S2: crash-zoom section reveals with pre-baked motion blur.
slots.S3: dust and grit overlay at 8% or less.
slots.S4: gauge needles, warning-stencil labels, heat-scorch maps.

themes.video: Rapid cutting with centered eye-trace, an orange-teal grade, speed ramps, war-drum percussion at 140 BPM or faster.
themes.data_skin: Gauges and needles, stencil labels, orange versus teal for rivals.
themes.boardroom: Avoid. For editorial work, Tempered keeps the palette and center framing and drops the stepped bursts.
themes.guardrails: No war-convoy vehicles, skull-and-wheel or faction emblems, characters, masks, flame-throwing guitars, or franchise names.

themes.seed: TX-11 WASTELAND CHROME: a full-throttle chase for scarce advantage; center-framed crash zooms; stencil-labeled gauges; orange versus teal rivals; sudden slow-motion on the decisive number.

themes.motion: Very slow: 2 to 6 s, `sine.inOut`. Slit-scan light corridors, a gravitational-lens ring, and silence as a beat: sections that hold completely still.

slots.S1: choose one: a slit-scan light corridor (VFX-JS slitScan) or a gravitational-lens ring around the key number (custom shader). Either is the page's one WebGL layer.
slots.S2: slow fades with long holds.
slots.S4: log-scale timelines, orbital diagrams, dual "time-dilation" clocks.

themes.video: Long static frames, intermission cards, organ or orchestral textures. A public-domain composition still needs a licensed or original recording.
themes.data_skin: Hairline strokes, log scales, ring diagrams.
themes.boardroom: Native. Keep the slow pacing; swap the shader for a static lens poster.
themes.guardrails: No black monolith, no red-eyed ship computer, no film ship designs, no bookshelf-dimension sets, no soundtrack recordings.
themes.collision: Sits near starfield builds. Use the corridor or the lens ring, not a starfield, as the S1.
themes.seed: TX-12 SLIT-SCAN COSMOS: a story about time at scale; one light corridor or lensing ring; log-scale timelines; silence held as deliberately as motion.

themes.name: HALFTONE MULTIVERSE
themes.feel: Comic panels, misregistered inks, one art style per world.

themes.look: White paper, CMYK process inks, misregistered color offsets, Ben-Day dots, thick keylines. The signature device: **each "world" (segment, persona, viewpoint) gets its own art style.**
themes.motion: Frame-stepped moves "on twos" (12 fps via `steps()`) for anything character-like, smooth moves for camera. Smash cuts, panel-to-panel camera, sound-effect words popping on impact.

slots.S1: comic panels burst into a split-screen hero, each panel in a different style (T2; VFX-JS halftone optional as the WebGL layer).
slots.S2: panel-to-panel transitions with on-twos stepping.
slots.S4: flat-ink charts with halftone shading and caption-box annotations, each segment drawn in its own visual dialect.

themes.video: Mixed frame rates (24 and 12), split screens, sound-effect words on hits, misregistration on cuts.
themes.data_skin: One style per segment, the theme's tool for personas and multiple perspectives.
themes.boardroom: Avoid. Tempered only for creative-adjacent editorial work.
themes.guardrails: No spider motifs, masks, suits, webs, franchise logos, or a comics publisher's trade dress.
themes.collision: Sits near persona and correlation-network builds; a different S1 family keeps it clear. Strong for fan communities, creators and TTRPG.
themes.seed: TX-18 HALFTONE MULTIVERSE: one dataset, many worlds; each persona or segment is drawn in its own art style; comic panels, misregistered inks, on-twos motion.

themes.name: SYMMETRY DIORAMA
themes.feel: Centered pastel dollhouse sections and whip-pan chapter cards.
themes.best_for: Org stories, team intros, product tours
themes.look: Pastel pink, butter yellow, mint and powder blue, with rust and aubergine accents. Dead-center symmetry, dollhouse cross-sections, centered chapter cards in Jost caps (an open-source geometric face in the Futura tradition).
themes.motion: Lateral tracking, whip pans (a fast horizontal swipe with pre-baked blur), snap zooms. Crisp 300 to 600 ms moves with precise stops.

slots.S1: a cross-section building whose rooms are the story's chapters; scroll tracks laterally room to room (a pinned horizontal scroll; mobile gets a native scroll-snap row).
slots.S2: whip-pan transitions and centered chapter cards.
slots.S4: pictogram rows, specimen-label charts, inventory tables.

themes.video: Symmetrical frames, lateral dollies, snap zooms, chapter cards, original chamber-pop plucked strings at 100 to 120 BPM.
themes.data_skin: Centered, labeled, inventory-like. Pictograms over bars.
themes.boardroom: Native. Mute the pastels about 15% for org and process stories.
themes.guardrails: No recreations of specific hotels, buildings, vehicles or sets from films, no film titles, no actor likenesses.
themes.collision: Sits near exploded technical-drawing builds. Differentiate with a pastel diorama, not line art. A natural fit for team intros and org stories.
themes.seed: TX-19 SYMMETRY DIORAMA: the organization as a pastel dollhouse cross-section; scroll tracks room to room; centered chapter cards; whip pans; every number shown as a labeled specimen.

themes.name: LIMINAL OFFICE
themes.feel: White corridors, teal carpet, and numbers that feel uneasy.
themes.best_for: Future of work, AI workforce, compliance
themes.look: Sterile white corridors, deep carpet green, pale teal, beige retro hardware, dark terminal panels with teal numerals. One-point corridors, sterile symmetry, low ceilings, isolated desks.
themes.motion: Deadpan. Clean cuts, long holds, precise slides at constant speed. Numbers drift in clusters. Fluorescent flicker stays at 3% opacity or less and 2 Hz or less.

slots.S1: an endless corridor in CSS 3D one-point perspective that scroll walks down; doors open onto chapters (T1).
slots.S2: clean slide-ins and held cuts.
slots.S3: the fluorescent hum at the safety limits.
slots.S4: a sorting interaction on a teal-on-black terminal grid: the reader drags numbers into bins, then sees the real distribution (predict-then-reveal).

themes.video: Long hallway dollies, symmetrical framing, uneasy synth pads under a warm office-music bed.
themes.data_skin: Grids of numerals, bins, completion percentages, sterile tables.
themes.boardroom: Native, and the strongest theme in the codex for AI-workforce briefs.
themes.guardrails: No company name, logo, founder imagery or mascot from any series, and none of its vocabulary for departments, workers or procedures.
themes.collision: Clear. Built for workforce, AI-plus-human staffing and compliance stories.
themes.seed: TX-20 LIMINAL OFFICE: the future of work as an endless white corridor; doors open onto chapters; the reader sorts the numbers before the real answer appears; constant speed, deadpan holds.
